The line items total $21,040 and tax is $1,472.80. The invoice total of $22,562.80 is $50 above that sum. The vendor must correct the total to $22,512.80 or add a line item for the difference.

WidgetA is billed at 22 units. WidgetB is billed at 18 units. GadgetX is billed at 9 units. These quantities exceed what can be accepted. The email should ask the vendor to revise these quantities without revealing internal stock levels.

I am drafting the vendor email now. It will open by stating the line items plus tax equal $22,512.80 and shipping is blank, so the invoice total of $22,562.80 is $50 above that sum with no supported charge.
